productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: A fun adventure through fuzzy land
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Fuzzy LandIs a cute and cozy adventure colouring book. Follow 5 friends, a Bee, Dragon, Fox, Frog and a marshmallow knight, as they embark on a journey across through fuzzy land. They through 9 different locationsover 42 colouring pages. During their adventure they use various magical and fantasy means of transportation, they encounter new friends and observe others from afar. They get in to some mischief, discover many magical and whimsical places. There is a bonus fully colourable map page so you can track your journey, (and your coloured pages)The only criticism (but it’s not enough to deduct any stars) I would of loved to have a page, for each of the main 5 characters, with a small/medium drawing showing them in full and introducing them. However there are small character profiles by visiting Molly on TT or IG. I have jotted the characters names in the book. Which is in the book description m, But for quick reference they are Bumble the Bee, Bao the Cloud Dragon, Frogy the Frog, Mallow the Marshmallow knight and Nym the Fox.Fuzzy land is lovely colouring book, ithas a nice mix of pages, with different levels detail, to suit any mood. Suitable for all ages and skills. Buy the book and begin your adventure with adorable 5 explores.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Perfect fantasy adventure story with the cutest original characters
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Fuzzy Land is so adorable! I absolutely cannot pick a favourite character because they are all so cute and have such distinct personalities that come out in each page. I absolutely adore how much variety there is in each page. Every page is a new adventure and has so much room for creativity and details. I really like the design of each character because they are so unique and I have never seen characters like Mallow or Bao before. And the inclusion of the map to track their journey throughout their adventure is such an awesome touch. This book will be perfect for a cover-to-cover so you can get the absolute most out of the story. Highly recommended. 1000/10
